input.prompt: Film still on 35mm, visible grain, warm hazy morning light. Extreme wide shot: a tiny lone figure in a long dark coat walks along the crest of a dune toward the rusted hull of a colossal ocean ship stranded in the middle of the desert, half-buried in sand, hundreds of times his height, its bow fading into the haze. A single line of footprints trails behind him across the dunes. Wind lifts a thin veil of sand off the crest. No sea anywhere in sight. The figure is the only living thing in the frame.
